product_one_liner.value: PolyAI builds and operates AI dialog agents for enterprises to handle complex customer-service conversations.

pricing_page.notes: The public page describes flexible, per-minute pricing.

hq_location.notes: The headquarters relocation announcement identifies 3 Sheldon Square, Paddington Central; PolyAI’s contact page lists that address as its London office.

eng_blog.notes: Technical posts include Principal Engineer Paul Annetts on backend infrastructure and CTO Shawn Wen on production dialog architectures and latency.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation covers agent configuration, integrations, API families, and error codes.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The three listed openings are Staff Product Manager, Senior Account Manager, and Senior Marketing Manager; none has a qualifying AI, ML, or data-science title.

model_provider.value: PolyAI’s proprietary Raven models, including Raven 3.5; OpenAI and Amazon Bedrock are also supported options.
model_provider.notes: Documentation recommends Raven 3.5; third-party options are available rather than necessarily used by every deployment.

compliance_certs.notes: The security page names all five, including SOC 2 Type 2.

last_funding.notes: The funding tracker reports an April 2026 $20 million Series D based on Companies House share-issuance filings, while noting that no public announcement was reported.

raised_18mo.notes: PolyAI announced an $86 million Series D on December 15, 2025, within the requested window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: None of the three listed openings is an SDR, BDR, or account executive role; the Senior Account Manager opening does not qualify.

launched_6mo.notes: PolyAI announced Dialog-RSN-1 availability on AWS SageMaker on October 6, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: PolyAI announced Sunil Shah’s appointment as Chief Financial Officer on October 8, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: A GTM Systems job description identifies Salesforce ownership and the surrounding sales and marketing tool suite.
